items.definition:
forgiveness for a fault or offense
He asked for a pardon for his mistake.

a structure built out over water
We walked along the pier at sunset.

the amount of rain that falls
The region receives high rainfall.

an act of playing something again
Let's watch the replay of the goal.

the act of revising
I need to do some revision for my exams.

a distinctive smell
The scent of roses filled the air.

a small peg used to hold a golf ball
He placed the ball on the tee.

a violent rotating column of air
The tornado caused widespread damage.

the body of words used in a particular language
Learning new vocabulary is important.

a medium-sized sailboat equipped for cruising or racing
They sailed their yacht across the bay.

a person who shoots with a bow and arrow
Robin Hood was a skilled archer.

a style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment
French cuisine is famous worldwide.

an obscuring of the light from one celestial body by the passage of another between it and the observer or between it and its source of illumination
We watched the solar eclipse with special glasses.

the state or process of taking pleasure in something
He found great enjoyment in reading books.

a momentary or partial view
I caught a glimpse of the celebrity as she walked by.

a sequence of single notes
The song has a beautiful melody.

a written message
I sent a memo to all staff about the new policy.

microphone
Can you hand me the mic?

the action of placing seeds or plants in the ground
We spent the afternoon planting new flowers in the garden.

a promotional video or advertisement
They released a new promo for the upcoming movie.

a person with whom one shares a room or apartment
My roommate is very tidy.

a warship designed to operate underwater
The submarine can stay submerged for weeks.

a person's state of mind regarding their emotions
He has a very short temper.

short for amplifier or ampere
He plugged his guitar into the amp.

a book of maps or charts
We used an old atlas to plan our road trip.

a wild or half-tamed horse of the western US
The cowboy tried to ride the bucking bronco.

a combination
This meal is a great combo of flavors.

a person who directs an orchestra or choir; a material that conducts electricity
The conductor raised his baton to begin the symphony.

Do It Yourself
He spent the weekend on a DIY project for his house.

a set of type of a particular face and size
Choose a clear font for the presentation.

a polite title or form of address for a woman
Excuse me, Madame, could you help me?

the sending and receiving of electronic messages
Instant messaging has become very popular.

a unit of weight equal to one sixteenth of a pound
This package weighs about ten ounces.

a movable model of a person or animal, used in entertainment
The children loved watching the puppet show.

bone in the chest
He broke a rib playing rugby.

bone framework
The human skeleton has 206 bones.

a lesson
I watched a tutorial on how to use the software.

heat; friendliness
I enjoyed the warmth of the sun.

chopping tool
He used an axe to chop the wood.

advisor
The school counselor helped me choose my courses.

support; motivation
Her words of encouragement helped him continue.

a player whose job is to prevent the ball from entering the goal
The goalkeeper made an amazing save.

a container for liquids; a baseball player who throws the ball
The pitcher threw a perfect game.

a large, heavily built crow with glossy black plumage
A large black raven landed on the branch.

the state or quality of being similar
There is a strong similarity between the two paintings.

a strip of material used to hold things together or in place
The strap of her bag broke.

a person or company offering something for sale
The street vendor sold hot dogs.

the SI unit of power
This light bulb uses 60 watts of electricity.

a person who works in a bank
My uncle is a successful banker.

a club or party at which people dance to pop music
We went to a disco last night.

a mass of small bubbles formed on or in liquid
The waves left a line of foam on the beach.

a glass building in which plants are grown that need protection from cold weather
We grow tomatoes in the greenhouse.

a person or machine that packs things
The packer carefully placed the fragile items into the box.

a formal dance held for a school's senior class
She bought a new dress for the prom.

a large heavy-bodied nonvenomous snake
The zookeeper fed the python a large rat.

a line or sequence of people or vehicles awaiting their turn to be attended to or to proceed
We had to wait in a long queue for tickets.

a common freshwater fish
We caught a large trout in the river.

an alcoholic drink distilled from fermented grain mash
He ordered a glass of whiskey at the bar.

a branch of mathematics dealing with symbols
She found algebra challenging but interesting.

a device used to transmit or receive signals
The television needs a new antenna to get a clear signal.

an interview for a role as a performer
She prepared for her audition all week.

any of the numerals from 0 to 9
Please enter the last four digits of your phone number.

a feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness
She felt a blush of embarrassment when she tripped.

a large group of animals, especially hoofed mammals, that live together or are kept together as livestock
A large herd of cattle grazed in the field.
